verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's documented Dashboard gives org-wide visibility into review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns, and the impact and ROI of AI-assisted reviews, with a companion page defining each review metric. That covers the core of an engineering lead's org-level analytics view. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of acceptance-rate metrics (suggestions accepted vs. dismissed), explicit review-coverage metrics, findings breakdowns by category or severity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
